title: Wetlands Vanish 3 Times Faster Than Forests
hook: Wetlands disappear 3 times faster than forests, weakening natural flood protection.
closing: Losing wetlands means dirtier water and harder floods where people live.
question: Which wetland protects your community?

segments.say: Wetland extent fell from 100 in 1970 to 65 in 2020, a 35% loss.
Wetlands lost 35% since 1970 versus forests' 12%, nearly three times faster.
Europe lost 50% of wetlands, more than Asia, Africa, or the Americas.
